editorial:
Set in present-day Chicago, this horror thriller follows a young paramedic whose life gets turned upside down when the ancient demon Lilith sets her sights on him. What starts as a normal night on the job quickly spirals into something much darker, as people around him start dying in strange ways and a mysterious woman seems to be pulling the strings. The movie mixes detective-style mystery with supernatural scares, so you never quite know what is real and what is a trick. The city setting gives it a gritty, late-night feel that works well for the story.

The acting is solid, especially from the lead, who sells the fear and confusion of someone being hunted by something he cannot understand. The pacing keeps things moving, with enough twists to keep you guessing until the end. On the downside, some of the effects look a little dated, and a few scenes feel rushed. Still, if you enjoy supernatural horror with a mystery angle, this is a fun ride. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, the paramedic discovers that Lilith has been using a human form to get close to him, and the deaths around him were part of her plan to break him down. After a tense showdown, he manages to stop her using an ancient ritual, but the last shot reveals that Lilith has already moved on to a new victim, hinting that the nightmare is far from over. The twist lands well and leaves you uneasy.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural horror with a mystery twist.
